draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane).

coaching.headline: Won on towers (10–4) and Cuban's 17/4 Sparrow despite losing the objective count — we converted leads to structures, which is what wins.
coaching.team: Classic good conversion: objectives were 14–17 against us, but we out-towered them 10–4 and Cuban snowballed his lane. Anti-heal was light (1 vs Narbash) and fine. The shape is right — take what fights we win straight to towers.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Keep converting kills to towers — that's why we won despite the neutral deficit. A second anti-heal would've made the Narbash fights faster.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow 17/4/1 won a favored read into Revenant — the win condition the tower conversion (10-4) keyed off.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Aurora jungle, 13 assists — elite enabling that set up Sparrow's 17/4 game.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Grux offlane into an unfavored Bayle (5/4/3) — held the lane while the team converted to a 10-4 tower win.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

fedBy: Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 88% of the team's kills (more than 98% of Boris jungle players this patch) and died 6 times (fewer than about 35% of them). Lotus turned 21 takedowns into ability haste, so Ursine Burst came back every ~47s instead of 80s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Boris touched shortened Ursine Burst, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 47.3s late); fight right after Ursine Burst is spent.
Ursine Burst at rank 3: 80s base, about 47.3s by the end (41% shorter) from 69 ability haste: Basilisk 20, Draconum 15, Lotus 34.
21 takedowns (15 kills, 6 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow), Lotus (Eternal).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Boris dealt 47,418 hero damage, 38% of their team's, with +167 physical power from items.

loadout.name: Endless Hunt
loadout.text: Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
loadout.plain: Each takedown resets Piercing Shot, Hail of Arrows and Heightened Senses and adds permanent armor penetration. After the first kill she can stealth again and keep fighting.

loadout.name: Thraex
loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: Basic attacks mark her target: she deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Fits her steady single-target attacking while Relentless stacks build.

loadout.name: Savage Strikes
loadout.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Adds a bit of damage to each basic attack that grows while she keeps hitting a hero, and heals her. Strong with Heightened Senses' attack speed.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed keeps rising each second Sparrow stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Sparrow more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot.

fedBy: Endless Hunt (augment): Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,494 hero damage a minute, more than 91% of Sparrow carry players this patch (34% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Onixian Quiver.
18 takedowns (17 kills, 1 assists) fed: Endless Hunt (augment).
Sparrow dealt 40,333 hero damage, 34% of their team's, with +152 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Revenant (level 14: about 91 physical armor, 79 after penetration; took 10,898 physical damage from heroes, 59% of all hero damage they took) and Narbash (level 15: about 125 physical armor, 113 after penetration; took 12,845 physical damage from heroes, 48% of all hero damage they took) that is about 7% and 6% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Ranged Basic Attack: Fire 2 additional projectiles. Each deals 10-35% (increases with Range) () Damage. Can Critically Strike and apply Lifesteal.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Melee Heroes only: Increase your Total Critical Strike Chance by 25%. Gain 1% Damage Mitigation for every 10% Missing Health.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 3,474 healing recorded.

Loadout augment Endless Hunt: Each takedown resets Piercing Shot, Hail of Arrows and Heightened Senses and adds permanent armor penetration. After the first kill she can stealth again and keep fighting. (game text: Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.) Field: 51.3% in 3687 games, 31% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout Eternal Thraex: Basic attacks mark her target: she deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Fits her steady single-target attacking while Relentless stacks build. (game text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).) Field: 50.1% in 1227 games, 10% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout minor Savage Strikes: Adds a bit of damage to each basic attack that grows while she keeps hitting a hero, and heals her. Strong with Heightened Senses' attack speed. (game text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.) [1.5 + 0.4 a level: 8.3 at level 17] Field: 49.9% in 1039 games, 85% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout minor Ferocity: Attack speed keeps rising each second Sparrow stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Sparrow more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes. (game text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.) Field: 50.5% in 1117 games, 91% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.2%.

Loadout crest Pacifier: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot. (game text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 52.7% in 3982 games, 33% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.2%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Onixian Quiver, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Onixian Quiver, Pacifier, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 3 of the 5 players Sparrow killed built physical armor (Narbash, Boris, Bayle). Anti-heal on Boris. We killed Sparrow 4 times.

Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 50.1% in 963 Sparrow carry games, level with the hero's 50.2%; this 3-item core: 56.8% in 628 games, level with the 56% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
